page.overview:
Who is Sigrid?

Sigrid was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Sigrid grew up in Tsimpo with her sister Stisk and their mother. It had been a Harkonnen village, but the villagers were met with indifference when they approached the Harkonnens asking for aid due to a deficiency in the water system. Sigrid and several other young villagers went behind the elders' back to House Atreides and Thufir Hawat agreed to help them, with Duke Leto Atreides assigning his best men to the job. The Harkonnens arrested several Atreides engineers, but Leto sent a garrison to free them and install the younger villagers as the new leadership of the village. Baron Vladimir Harkonnen sent his twisted mentat Piter de Vries, who destroyed Tsimpo and had the young leadership executed, including Sigrid.

Stisk later led her crew of smugglers, consisting of Valentin, Zoe, Maax and Chingo to the ruins of Tsimpo. They found a necklace belonging to Sigrid in buried in the sand and used it open a hidden door in a box canyon. They found a a Mark IV medium CHOAM gunship inside, which they used to smuggle a lot of alcohol back to Carthag.
